To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) emotions can influence which books we choose to read, (b) emotions are elicited and transformed by reading narrative fiction, (c) emotions influence our experience of reading narrative fiction, and (d) emotions experienced during reading can influence our experience of our lives.

(1) People choose to read a book to change or maintain a particular emotional state; (2) The narrative of a book influences the emotions that a person feels; and (3) The emotions experienced during reading influence how the narrative is experienced.
(1) affect and mood can influence book choice; (2) the narrative can evoke and transform emotions; and (3) these emotions can in their turn influence the experience of the narrative.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how emotions influence and are influenced by the experience of reading narrative fiction.
the interaction between emotions, narrative fiction, and the self.
the interaction between emotions (affect) and narrative fiction, both as a process and as a product.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interaction between emotions in readers and narrative fiction is complex and dynamic.
the relationship between emotions and literary narratives is complex and dynamic, with reciprocal influences between the reader and the narrative.
the interaction between narrative fiction and emotion is complex and multifaceted, but also that the current empirical research provides a good foundation for future work.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
emotions and literary narrative are inextricably intertwined, but that much remains to be learned about the nature of that relationship.
emotions and narrative fiction interact at every stage of the experience of reading.
emotions are a central and important part of the experience of narrative fiction, but much remains to be understood about the nature and extent of their influence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
emotions are central to narrative fiction and that they interact with the text in complex ways.
emotions are a crucial component of narrative experience.
the relationship between emotions and narrative is a two-way street.
